description: This file defines the internal readonly struct ObserverGrainId within the Orleans.Runtime namespace. It provides methods and properties for creating, parsing, and comparing observer grain identifiers, which are used to identify client-side observer objects in Orleans. The struct includes logic for constructing grain IDs, checking if a grain ID is an observer, and formatting the ID as a string.

classes.name: ObserverGrainId
classes.description: A struct that uniquely identifies a client-side observer object in Orleans, providing creation, parsing, comparison, and formatting functionalities.

methods.description: Creates a new ObserverGrainId for a given ClientGrainId, generating a new GUID-based scoped ID.

methods.name: IsObserverGrainId
methods.description: Checks if a given GrainId represents an observer ID by verifying if it is a client and contains the segment separator.

methods.description: Attempts to parse a GrainId into an ObserverGrainId, returning true if successful.

methods.description: Constructs a GrainId from a ClientGrainId and a scoped IdSpan.
